_specs: The design name comes from the Shopify image filename, the only record of what the print is. Nothing about the artwork is invented.
buyBody: Plain black, with the mark inside the collar rather than on the chest. The quietest shirt we make and the one that works anywhere a collar is required.
pieceHeadline: No print. That's the whole idea.
pieceParas: Every other Classic carries a pattern. This one does not, and the only branding is inside the collar where nobody but you will see it.

It is the shirt for the golfer who wants performance fabric and a proper collar and would rather not advertise anything at all. It also happens to be the one that goes to dinner afterwards without a change.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body, off-course as much as on. This is the one that leaves the golf course, so photograph it doing that — clubhouse, evening light. There is no on-body apparel photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
